step 15: put back /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d
  evict: an admit that stopped while it installed Docker left its hold on Docker's daemons; your own policy-rc.d, if you had one, goes back, and what that install claimed is recorded as installed
  run:
    $ set -e
    $ release_docker_hold() {
    $   rm -f /usr/sbin/.policy-rc.d.paisans-tmp /usr/sbin/.policy-rc.d.paisans-owner-tmp
    $   if [ -f /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d ] && [ ! -L /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d ] && grep -qxF '# Written by paisans host admit while it installs Docker, and removed after.' /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d; then
    $     if [ -e /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d.paisans-owner ] || [ -L /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d.paisans-owner ]; then
    $       mv -f /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d.paisans-owner /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d
    $     else
    $       rm -f /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d
    $     fi
    $   elif [ -e /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d.paisans-owner ] || [ -L /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d.paisans-owner ]; then
    $     if [ ! -e /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d ] && [ ! -L /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d ]; then
    $       mv -f /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d.paisans-owner /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d
    $     elif [ -L /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d ] && [ -L /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d.paisans-owner ] && [ "$(readlink /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d)" = "$(readlink /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d.paisans-owner)" ]; then
    $       rm -f /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d.paisans-owner
    $     elif [ ! -L /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d ] && [ ! -L /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d.paisans-owner ] && cmp -s /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d.paisans-owner; then
    $       rm -f /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d.paisans-owner
    $     fi
    $   fi
    $ }
    $ release_docker_hold
    $ if [ -e /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d.paisans-owner ] || [ -L /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d.paisans-owner ]; then echo '/usr/sbin/policy-rc.d.paisans-owner, a copy of your policy-rc.d admit made while it installed Docker, differs from the /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d there now. Keep the one you want as /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d, remove the other, and run again'; exit 1; fi
    $ confirm_claims() {
    $   f=/etc/paisans/installed
    $   { [ -f "$f" ] && [ ! -L "$f" ]; } || return 0
    $   ok=
    $   for p in $(awk 'NF == 2 && $1 == "installing" && $2 ~ /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.+-]+$/ { print $2 }' "$f"); do
    $     if dpkg-query -W -f='${Status}' "$p" 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'ok installed$'; then ok="$ok $p"; fi
    $   done
    $   [ -n "$ok" ] || return 0
    $   awk -v ok="$ok " 'NF == 2 && $1 == "installing" && index(ok, " " $2 " ") { print "package " $2; next } { print }' "$f" > "$f.paisans-tmp" &&
    $     chmod 644 "$f.paisans-tmp" && mv -f "$f.paisans-tmp" "$f"
    $ }
    $ confirm_claims

step 19: remove the registry entry
  evict: deployment f2a9 from /var/lib/paisans/registry.json
  run:
    $ set -e; umask 077; [ -f /var/lib/paisans/registry.json ] || exit 0; exec 9>>/var/lib/paisans/registry.lock; flock -w 60 9 || { echo 'paisans: another command holds /var/lib/paisans/registry.lock'; exit 1; }; tmp=$(mktemp /var/lib/paisans/.registry.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT; awk '-v' 'id=f2a9c4e1-0b7d-4c3a-9e2f-5a6b7c8d9e01' '-v' 'header={"version":1,"deployments":{' '-v' 'footer=}}' '-v' 'unreadable=paisans-registry-unreadable' '
    $ NR == 1 { if ($0 != header) bad = 1; next }
    $ done { if ($0 != "") bad = 1; next }
    $ $0 == footer { done = 1; next }
    $ {
    $ 	line = $0
    $ 	sub(/,$/, "", line)
    $ 	if (line !~ /^"[^"]+":\{.*\}$/) { bad = 1; next }
    $ 	key = substr(line, 2, index(line, "\":") - 2)
    $ 	if (key == id) next
    $ 	kept[++n] = line
    $ }
    $ END {
    $ 	if (NR > 0 && !done) bad = 1
    $ 	if (bad) { print unreadable > "/dev/stderr"; exit 4 }
    $ 	print header
    $ 	for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
    $ 		if (i < n) print kept[i] ","
    $ 		else print kept[i]
    $ 	}
    $ 	print footer
    $ }
    $ ' /var/lib/paisans/registry.json > "$tmp"; chmod 600 "$tmp"; mv "$tmp" /var/lib/paisans/registry.json
